patthana14.16:1.1: āsavañceva sāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavoceva na anāsavoca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: āsavañceva sāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na anāsavoceva na nocaāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: āsavañceva sāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavoceva na anāsavoca na anāsavoceva na nocaāsavo dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana14.16:2.1: sāsavañceva nocaāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anāsavoceva na nocaāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana14.16:3.1: āsavañceva sāsavañca sāsavañceva nocaāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavoceva na anāsavoca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana14.16:4.1: hetuyā nava sabbattha nava. āsavaāsavasampayuttaduke naāsavaāsavasampayuttadukaṃ
